_about: Public-domain George Gillespie (1613-1648, Scottish commissioner to the Westminster Assembly) for the Word Hoard: vol. 1 of his Works (Edinburgh: Ogle, 1846, ed. W. M. Hetherington) as a Gutenberg transcription, and, from an Internet Archive scan, raw OCR, Aaron's Rod Blossoming (Edinburgh: Ogle, 1844), the main book of the Works' vol. 2, which neither Gutenberg nor IA holds as the 1846 volume. CCEL holds none of it. Added 2026-10-02 by lane A, round 7 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
